body: Fix for incident i-codex-broker-leak. Landed on VectorCraft main as 8d77ed9 (pushed 2026-10-21 17:20Z). It includes the per-review broker stop, reap (dead worker pid or gone checkout), branch-queue/, empty-diff coverage, and branch reviews replacing post-commit. BewareILive copies it with the reap prefix changed to bil-review-* and keeps the path normalization.
summary: codex-review stops each review's Codex broker when the review ends, plus a reap sweep
